ItemID: NA; Title: High Hopes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar rock fits my recent listening, but I would only pick a couple of albums today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Nothing Has Changed; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A career-spanning collection is less appealing right now than another blues-rock album.
ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Pop ballads are not what I am looking for on this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Before This World; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The mellow singer-songwriter sound appeals, but it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Old Yellow Moon; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy country direction interests me, though I am leaning toward blues guitar today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Morning Phase; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its subdued atmosphere is less suited to my current interest in guitar-driven music.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wallflower; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Jazz-oriented interpretations do not feel like a close enough match for this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Step Back; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Blues guitar is a strong fit with my recent Clapton and Hendrix listening; I would try this.
ItemID: NA; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Guitar-led blues rock feels like a natural next listen after Old Sock and People, Hell & Angels.
ItemID: NA; Title: Screamin' for My Supper; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The bluesy rock sound interests me, but my two guitar-focused picks are enough today.
